weather_report:
As the night deepens over Boston, the sky remains predominantly clear, softly illuminated by the scattered lights of the city below. A gentle southwest breeze caresses the air, carrying hints of warmth as it whispers through the quiet neighborhoods. With the temperature settling around a comfortable 71 degrees, it invites an evening of casual strolls and relaxed conversation in the cool, comforting embrace of late summer.

Tomorrow promises a sunlit embrace, with the horizon poised to bask in a vibrant 91 degrees as the day unfolds. With a warm west wind nudging the air, it will be an exquisite day for outdoor pursuits—perhaps a leisurely visit to the local park or a quiet moment spent sipping coffee on a sunlit patio. Dressing in light fabrics and donning sunglasses will be essential to chase away the rising heat, as the sun encourages revelry in the beauty of midsummer. As the sun rises and sets, Boston will thrive, offering a gentle reminder of the serene allure of these summer nights and days, each moment bathed in the golden glow of perfect weather.
